# Migrate to TestPion

::: tip In short
Moving from Postman, Insomnia, Bruno or another tool? Drop your files on the window. TestPion shows what will be created and what came over fully.
:::

Drop the files (or a folder, a ZIP, a repository link) on the window, or open **Home ▸ Migrate from…**, pick your tool, and follow the steps: the Import dialog **previews** what will be created and the **compatibility report** says what came over fully, with changes, or not at all. Scripts are converted to TestPion's `tp.*`. A second import of the same source **updates** what it made. One page per tool:

- [Postman](/migrate/postman): Collection v2.0 and v2.1 (JSON)
- [Insomnia](/migrate/insomnia): v5 YAML (`collection.insomnia.rest/5.x`, what Insomnia 10+ exports)
- [Bruno](/migrate/bruno): A collection folder (`bruno.json`, `collection.bru`, `folder.bru`, request `.bru` files, `environments/`, `.env`)
- [Hoppscotch](/migrate/hoppscotch): Collection exports (JSON; REST and GraphQL collections)
- [Thunder Client](/migrate/thunder): Collection exports (`clientName: "Thunder Client"`: `folders` and `requests`)
- [Yaak](/migrate/yaak): The workspace export (JSON, `yaakSchema`)
- [HTTPie](/migrate/httpie): HTTPie for Desktop collection and environment exports (`meta.format: "httpie"`)
- [Apidog](/migrate/apidog): The Apidog project export (`apidogProject`; Apifox's `apifoxProject` too)

## What each importer supports

| Feature | [Postman](/migrate/postman) | [Insomnia](/migrate/insomnia) | [Bruno](/migrate/bruno) | [Hoppscotch](/migrate/hoppscotch) | [Thunder Client](/migrate/thunder) | [Yaak](/migrate/yaak) | [HTTPie](/migrate/httpie) | [Apidog](/migrate/apidog) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Folders and requests | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Auth | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Variables and environments | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Scripts converted to tp.* | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no | yes |
| Tests and assertions | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Saved responses | yes | no | yes | yes | no | no | no | yes |
| gRPC and WebSocket | no | yes | yes | no | no | yes | no | no |
| Updates on re-import | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Write back (export) | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no | no | no |

Other formats import too: OpenAPI and Swagger, AsyncAPI, WSDL, HAR, `.http` files, `.env` files, GraphQL schemas, Arazzo workflows, and a copied cURL, fetch, PowerShell or HTTPie command. See [Export and import](/getting-started/export-import) and [Import fidelity](/getting-started/import-fidelity).
